items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Yeah, that was a fellow named Lawrence Hall. He was a wonderful trumpet player too.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was a fellow named Lawrence Hall. He was a wonderful trumpet player too. And he used to just sort of sit there, song his violin. He used to come to Pointville to give dances. He'd stay at the door and pick up the tickets, you understand? But he never would stand out in front of the band like that. Very seldom, I've never seen him stand out.
So I didn't know what kind of a band this was.
